title: OpenAI and Los Alamos National Laboratory announce research partnership
summary: OpenAI and Los Alamos National Laboratory are working to develop safety evaluations to assess and measure biological capabilities and risks associated with frontier models.
body: OpenAI and Los Alamos National Laboratory are working to develop safety evaluations to assess and measure biological capabilities and risks associated with frontier models.
summaryZh: OpenAI宣布与美国洛斯阿拉莫斯国家实验室（LANL）建立战略研究伙伴关系，双方将合作开发针对前沿人工智能模型的生物安全评估方法。此举旨在科学衡量和防范大模型在生物学应用领域可能带来的潜在风险，对推动前沿AI的安全监管与基准测试具有重要影响。
